_note: Sources for Form 2 Accounting (Batches A2-1, A2-2 and A2-3, Terms 1–3), a new subject in Form 2. Computations are done by code; the rules are authored and must be checked by an Accounting teacher.

financial-position.ref: The financial position of an enterprise and the balance sheet (OHADA / SYSCOHADA vocabulary simplified for Form 2)
financial-position.supports: Assets, liabilities and owner's equity; fixed and current assets; presentation of the balance sheet; the equation Assets = Liabilities + Owner's equity and how transactions change it.
financial-position.checked: Standard accounting principles; totals computed by code. Please check the terms used against the school's textbook (e.g. capital / owner's equity, debtors / creditors).

economic-flows.ref: Economic flows (real and financial) between the enterprise and its partners; accounting analysis (the receiving account is debited, the giving account credited)
economic-flows.supports: Classification of flows, flow diagrams, the debit/credit analysis of common transactions.
economic-flows.checked: Authored from general accounting principles: please check.

recording.ref: Ledger (T) accounts; the functioning of balance sheet, expense and revenue accounts; balancing; single and double entry; the trial balance and the reciprocity of accounts
recording.supports: Debit = left, credit = right; assets increase on the debit side, capital and liabilities on the credit side; expenses debited, revenues credited; balances computed by code; trial balance totals.
recording.checked: Standard double-entry rules; balances computed by code. Please check.

ohada.ref: OHADA treaty (Port Louis, 1993; 17 member states) and the revised SYSCOHADA chart of accounts (2017): classes 1–9, codification, ordinary and HAO activities, parallelism of accounts, content of classes 1–8
ohada.supports: Account numbers used: 101, 103, 162, 223, 231, 241, 244, 2441, 245, 311, 321, 401, 411, 422, 521, 55, 571, 601, 605, 661, 701, 702, 706, 77, 79, 81, 812, 82, 822, 83–89; class = first digit, main account = first two digits (computed); result = income − expenses (computed).
ohada.checked: From general knowledge of SYSCOHADA, not opened in this session: an accounting teacher must check the account names against the official chart.

business-finance.ref: Business finance: own funds, borrowed funds, subsidies (14 investment, 71 operating); long-term loans (162), leasing (crédit-bail), short-term loans; simple interest
business-finance.supports: Rows 20–21; interest = loan × rate × time computed.
business-finance.checked: SYSCOHADA account numbers from general knowledge: please check.

investments.ref: Fixed assets: classification (21 intangible, 22–24 tangible, 27 financial), acquisition cost, entries (481 suppliers of fixed assets, 72 own production), contributed and subsidised assets
investments.checked: Please check the account numbers against the official chart.

trading.ref: Trading documents (purchase order, delivery note, invoice, credit note, receipt), inventory, mark-up on cost and margin on sales, invoice calculation with trade discount and VAT 19.25% (Cameroon), cash and bank transactions, cash book
trading.supports: Rows 24–26; stock, mark-up, margin, invoice and cash balance computed.
trading.checked: VAT rate 19.25% (17.5% + additional council tax) from general knowledge: please check.
